__comment: Tag-52 Phase-3-Marathon Final-Pre-Cutover SLO-Dashboard (Noa Bergstroem / SRE). Consolidated single-view SLO surface across all Phase-3 Marathon SLOs, designed for the AR-Pre-Cutover-Sichtung and the Cutover-Day-Morgen operator. Every panel maps to exactly one SLO defined in docs/observability/sli-slo-phase-3-marathon.md (Tag-52 SLI/SLO catalogue). The dashboard is intentionally additive to and disjoint from: (a) phase-3c-cross-welle-coordination.json (Tag-40 71-panel deep-view), (b) phase-3c-cutover-day-live-stream.json (Tag-41 7-panel realtime view), (c) persona-engine-phase-3c-welle-status.json (Tag-30/31/32 per-Welle lifecycle). This dashboard is the SLO/Error-Budget rollup; the others are operational deep-views. Seven SLO groups (Welle-Cutover-Success-Rate / Cross-Modul-Drift-Rate / Alert-Volume-Trend / AR-Hand-Stop-Trigger-Rate / Build-Reproducibility / SBOM-Verdict / Cosign-OIDC-Drift) plus a Marathon-Health composite header. Schema version Grafana 10.x (schemaVersion 38). Sole datasource UID 'prom' (Prometheus). Anchors: ADR-0066 Phase-3c Marathon, ADR-0064 Phase-2 SLI/SLO substrate, ADR-0025 SRE-Performance-Mess-Anker. Cross-refs: docs/observability/sli-slo-phase-1b.md (Tag-15 Phase-1b SLOs), docs/observability/sli-slo-wat-phase-2.md (Tag-15 WAT-Pipeline SLOs).
title: Wakir - Phase-3-Marathon Final-Pre-Cutover SLO-Dashboard

panels.title: Phase-3-Marathon Aggregate Health Score (0-100)
panels.__comment: Composite health gauge from the Tag-40 health-score emitter. The single number that summarises Marathon-readiness. Thresholds align with the Tag-40 alert-rules: <50 page (red), 50-75 ticket (orange), 75-90 watch (yellow), 90-100 healthy (green). This panel duplicates the gauge from the Tag-40 71-panel dashboard intentionally so the SLO-rollup view is self-contained; the parent dashboard remains the operational deep-view.

panels.title: Wellen signed-off / 7 (Marathon Progress)
panels.__comment: Per-Welle state-machine signed-off count. Marathon-COMPLETE requires all 7 Wellen at state==3 (signed-off). Source: persona_engine_phase_3c_welle_state (Tag-30 emitter). Stat shows current count; the deeper per-Welle detail is in the Tag-30 dashboard.

panels.title: Marathon-Progress percent (Tag-30 emitter)
panels.__comment: Same intent as panel 3 but sourced from the Tag-30 emitter's percent-pre-computed gauge. Kept as a cross-check on the count-based panel: if these two disagree, the emitter and the underlying state-machine have drifted (Zone-I Tomas + Zone-A Aisha review trigger). Source: persona_engine_phase_3c_marathon_progress_pct.

panels.title: SLO-1 Welle-Cutover-Success-Rate per Welle (rate, 6h window)
panels.__comment: Per-Welle Cutover-Success-Rate = (signed-off transitions over the window) / (signed-off + rolled-back transitions). Computed from the Tag-30 welle-state-emitter via the persona_engine_phase_3c_welle_decisions_total and persona_engine_phase_3c_welle_fallback_total counters; a 6h rate window matches the SLO-1 evaluation window in the SLO doc. Target: success-rate per Welle >= 99% (1% rolled-back budget per Welle per window).

panels.title: SLO-1 Error-Budget burn (current 1h rate-multiplier)
panels.__comment: Burn-rate gauge: how many error-budgets-per-hour the fallback-rate is currently consuming. Computed as rate(fallback_total[1h]) / (1% * rate(decisions_total[1h])). A value of 1.0 means we are burning exactly the budget; 5.0 means 5x faster than the budget allows (5x-page-trigger threshold). Single rolled-up number across all Wellen.

panels.title: SLO-2 Cross-Modul-Drift Count over Time
panels.__comment: Cross-Modul-Drift count from the Phase-2 Acceptance-Gate cross-modul-stress-score output. Source: wakir_cross_modul_drift_count. SLO target: drift_count == 0 over rolling 96h windows. Any non-zero value is the canonical 'Wave caused module-stress shift > 0.5pp baseline' signature (ADR-0066 immediate-rollback-trigger). The accompanying alert WakirPhase3CrossModulDriftDetected pages at increase > 0 for 60s.

panels.title: SLO-2 Drift Events / 24h (Error-Budget = 0)
panels.__comment: Stat-counter: number of distinct drift-events over the trailing 24h window. SLO target: 0 events per 24h. Error-budget is hard-zero for Cross-Modul-Drift; any RED non-zero state requires Mira+Tomas+Henrik triage per ADR-0066 §A1-Cross-Modul-Drift-Mitigation.

panels.title: SLO-3 Alert Volume per Severity (firing alerts, 5m rate)
panels.__comment: Alert-volume-trend derived from the ALERTS pseudo-metric Prometheus emits for every active alert rule. Series broken out by severity (page / ticket / log). SLO target: page-alert volume <= 2 per 24h during pre-cutover steady state; cutover-day spike up to 20/day expected. Alert-fatigue threshold: >50 page-alerts per 24h triggers a Noa-Alert-Rule-Review (own-dogfooding).

panels.title: SLO-3 Current Firing Page-Alerts (instant)
panels.__comment: Instant count of severity=page alerts currently firing. SLO target: 0 page-alerts in steady-state. During cutover-day expected transient values up to 3 during Welle-handover; sustained > 5 is an SRE-attention condition.

panels.title: SLO-4 AR-Hand-Stop-Marker Trigger Frequency (rate, 1h)
panels.__comment: AR-Hand-Stop-Trigger-Rate from the wakir_ar_hand_stop_marker_total counter. SLO target: total marker fires <= 3 over the entire Marathon (KW-24..27) - the AR-Hand-Stop is the human-final-line and should fire only at expected Welle-handover checkpoints. The Tag-45 B1 alert WakirPhase3ARHandStopMissing fires when the marker is silent at a planned checkpoint; this panel surfaces the inverse trend.

panels.title: SLO-4 AR-Hand-Stop-Triggers / Marathon-to-date
panels.__comment: Cumulative AR-Hand-Stop-Marker fires since Marathon start. SLO target: <= 3 fires over KW-24..27. A value >= 4 indicates either (a) more handover-checkpoints occurred than the Marathon plan calls for (Mira-review) or (b) a planning-vs-execution drift (Aisha + Mira retro). Reset-semantics: the counter is monotonic; Marathon-to-date is approximated via the wider time-range selector.

panels.title: SLO-5 Build-Reproducibility Drift Count (15 binaries)
panels.__comment: Aggregate count of binaries with non-deterministic fingerprints across the 15-binary release manifest. Source: wakir_build_reproducibility_drift_count (Tag-47 verify-15-binary-build-reproducibility.py output). SLO target: drift_count == 0 (all 15 binaries reproducible). Non-zero is a release-cut blocker per ADR-0066 §Cutover-Day-Acceptance-Gate.

panels.title: SLO-5 Per-Binary Reproducibility Verdict
panels.__comment: Per-binary deterministic-verdict table from the verify-15-binary-build-reproducibility script. 1 = byte-equal across the two derivation passes, 0 = drift. The whole-table-green is the cutover-acceptance signal; the row-level red surfaces which binary needs investigation (Reza for wirelang binaries, Tomas for wat binaries, Kai for orchestrator binaries). Source: wakir_build_reproducibility_deterministic{binary=...}.

panels.title: SLO-6 SBOM Aggregate Verdict (0=fail / 1=pass)
panels.__comment: Tag-49 verify-15-binary-sbom-against-baseline aggregate verdict. 1 = all 15 binaries' SBOMs match their pinned baseline within the allowed transitive-package set; 0 = at least one binary drifts. SLO target: aggregate_verdict == 1 at every cutover-acceptance gate. Source: wakir_sbom_verification_aggregate_verdict.

panels.title: SLO-6 SBOM Binaries by Verdict
panels.__comment: Per-verdict count of binaries from the SBOM-verification run (pass / fail / unknown). Source: wakir_sbom_verification_binaries_by_verdict_count{verdict=...}. The full-15 PASS bar is the steady-state cutover-acceptance shape; any FAIL or UNKNOWN bar > 0 is a release blocker.

panels.title: SLO-6 SBOM Drift Count Trend (per-binary, 7d)
panels.__comment: Per-binary SBOM-drift-count trend over the last 7 days. Each line is one binary; the value is the count of transitive packages drifting from the baseline at each sample. SLO target: all lines flat at 0. A rising line is the canonical 'transitive dependency shifted' signal that Reza/Tomas/Kai need to triage before cutover. Source: wakir_sbom_verification_per_binary_drift_count.

panels.title: SLO-7 Cosign-OIDC Aggregate Drift (0=ok / 1=drift)
panels.__comment: Tag-48 cosign-keyless-oidc-drift-probe aggregate signal. 1 = at least one binary's cosign-verify response now binds to a different OIDC issuer/subject than the pinned baseline; 0 = all signatures bind to the expected trust-root. SLO target: aggregate == 0 always. Drift is a supply-chain alarm (the keyless-OIDC binding changed unexpectedly) and is a release-blocker per ADR-0066 §Supply-Chain-Cutover-Gate. Source: wakir_cosign_drift_probe_aggregate.

panels.title: SLO-7 Cosign-Trust-Root (1=pinned-match)
panels.__comment: Trust-root pin verification. Source: wakir_cosign_drift_probe_trust_root. 1 = the public-good Fulcio + Rekor trust roots cosign-keyless validates against still match the pinned values from the ADR-0066 supply-chain-bundle; 0 = the trust-root rotated (rare but cutover-relevant event). SLO target: trust_root == 1 at every cutover-acceptance gate.

panels.title: SLO-7 Cosign-OIDC Per-Binary Drift
panels.__comment: Per-binary cosign-drift verdict. 1 = OIDC binding drifted from baseline; 0 = pinned-match. Source: wakir_cosign_drift_probe_per_binary{binary=...}. Operator-runbook: a drifted row means the binary was re-signed against a different OIDC subject (e.g. CI service-account rotation, branch-trigger change). Cross-check with the cosign-keyless-oidc-baseline-bundle before deciding release-block vs accept-and-rebaseline.

panels.title: Tag-52 SLO-Dashboard Anchor
panels.__comment: Doc-anchor text panel. Surfaces the SLO-doc cross-reference and Marathon-COMPLETE conjunction definition so the operator-on-shift can re-validate at-a-glance which gauges count as cutover-blocking vs operator-watch.

options.content:
### Tag-52 Phase-3-Marathon Final Pre-Cutover SLO-Dashboard

**SLO catalogue:** `docs/observability/sli-slo-phase-3-marathon.md` (Tag-52, Noa-SRE).

**Cutover-blocking SLOs (release-gate, all must be GREEN):**

- SLO-1 Welle-Cutover-Success-Rate: per-Welle success-rate >= 99% over 6h
- SLO-2 Cross-Modul-Drift-Rate: drift_count == 0 over 24h
- SLO-5 Build-Reproducibility: drift_count == 0 (15/15 binaries deterministic)
- SLO-6 SBOM-Verdict: aggregate_verdict == 1 (15/15 binaries match baseline)
- SLO-7 Cosign-OIDC-Drift: aggregate == 0 AND trust_root == 1

**Operator-watch SLOs (informational, do not auto-block):**

- SLO-3 Alert-Volume-Trend: page-alerts <= 2/24h steady, <= 20/24h cutover-day
- SLO-4 AR-Hand-Stop-Trigger-Rate: <= 3 fires per Marathon

**Marathon-COMPLETE conjunction (5-way AND, defined in Tag-40 dashboard):**

1. All 7 Wellen at `persona_engine_phase_3c_welle_state == 3` (signed-off)
2. `wakir_henrik_audit_signoff == 1` (Henrik Phase-3-Schluss-Audit)
3. No Welle in `state == 4` (rolled-back)
4. `wakir_cross_modul_drift_count == 0` (Phase-2 Acceptance-Gate)
5. `wakir_ar_hand_final_signoff_phase_3 == 1` (AR-Hand-Final)

**Cross-refs:** Tag-40 phase-3c-cross-welle-coordination (operational deep-view), Tag-41 phase-3c-cutover-day-live-stream (realtime per-Welle), Tag-30 persona-engine-phase-3c-welle-status (per-Welle lifecycle).
